career_spells.role: Early family farm responsibilities and post-school farm work
career_spells.evidence_note: First speech says accepted family-business responsibility at14; paid status and school/study overlap unknown. No birth-year arithmetic or assumption of full-time childhood work. This may overlap later farming and must not be added twice. In2015 he specifically describes two years working on the family farm with Allan after high-school graduation and before moving to Muresk, to attain independent student-support status;2018speech repeats two-year work sequence. This distinguishes post-school work from childhood responsibilities, but neither speech dates it or specifies weekly hours, pay arrangement or uninterrupted full-time status. General2015benefit criteria are not his historical employment evidence.

research_notes: 2026-10-01 initial research: frozen official occupations, MP biography and first-speech PDF, contemporary PGA submission held by ACCC, local farm history, ABR indexed partnership, alumni newsletter and declared-interest transcription.

Full-time status/hours, early farm pay, study/other employment and breaks remain unresolved.25yearpartnership narrative versus1990start retained as discrepancy; no backward arithmetic adopted as a date. Candidate campaign lasted about2.5years before2013speech; farm workload during campaigning needs evidence.

Searched explicit full-time, Muresk/Curtin graduation, PGA employer records/annual-report leads, farm legal names and publicly indexed professional material. Numerous US/Canadian namesakes excluded.2022FarmWeekly profile open Error fetching; original APH bio/interest link and ABR historical page Internal Error; alternative primary first-speech and ACCC document accessible.

Follow-up: Indinup partnership historical changes and pay/hours; pre1990 roles; study attendance and leave;2013 farming exit versus subsequent financial partnership; PGA pay/tenure, local party offices and earlier investment directorships.2022FarmWeekly detailed career interview remains a useful lead.

Follow-up2026-10-02:2015 and2018personal Hansard resolve two-year post-school family-farm work before Muresk, enriching early chronology. No unlocated employer invented; account specifically names family farm in2015. Avoid adding two years mechanically to1990–2013 farming range or inferring full-time from benefit independence.

FarmWeekly detailed profile https://www.farmweekly.com.au/story/7812275/political-career-inspired-by-life-on-the-land/ returned (500) redirected to tollbit.farmweekly.com.au, non-retryable; not retried. ABR historical partnership view again unavailable. Other public parliamentary material remained usable.

Targeted Muresk graduation/attendance, early farm and working-time searches did not recover exact years. US/Canadian namesakes and staff job vacancies discarded. Next leads: Muresk original graduation/attendance records, partnership and farm pay records, historical pre-study dates,2013operating exit versus retained financial interests, association role remuneration.

Follow-up 2026-10-03: located a public2019 first-person electorate listing stating that Rick and Allan continued to operate and expand the family farm. This conflicts with treating the official1990–2013 self-employed range as a complete operational cutoff, but does not establish Rick's personal post-entry hours, pay or continuity; retained financial and possible operative involvement remain unresolved and are not added as full-time years.
